title: Python: Slot Coordination oracle implementation
description:
Python oracle for GCP-6 Slot Coordination: superframe synchronization, slot allocation (interleaved/contiguous), conflict resolution (lowest IID wins), CoAP resource simulation.

MUST/SHALL Checklist (extracted from spec 08-gateway-coordination.md GCP-6):
[ ] 6.2: Both interleaved and contiguous slot allocation options MUST be supported
[ ] 6.3: On overlapping slot claims, lowest IID MUST win
[ ] 6.3: Loser MUST select next available slot and re-claim
[ ] 6.3: Loser MUST broadcast updated schedule via CoAP to peers and LoRa announces
[ ] 6.3: Gateways MUST verify Schnorr signature on slot-claim messages
[ ] 6.3: Claims with invalid/missing signatures MUST be silently discarded
[ ] 6.3: Overlapping claims where both signatures verify MUST be resolved by lowest IID
[ ] 6.3: When one signature fails and one succeeds, valid claim MUST be accepted, invalid MUST be ignored
close_reason: Already fixed: Python oracle for GCP-6 Slot Coordination fully implemented in python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py (454 lines) with 83 passing tests. All requirements met: slot map validation, TX allowed checks, multi-root conflict resolution (RootCandidate/select_root), IID tiebreaks, MultiRootState with holdoff handling, and RPL version change handling per spec 2a.5.4.
